body: You own Q11 - the three strands of a camp. research/TASK_Q11.md is self-contained; read it and nothing else. You have a shell, so this is MODULE AND TEST TOGETHER: new Godot/scripts/TrainingStrands.gd (zero preloads, all static), its test, then a small ledger beside technique_progress at AthleteDevelopment.gd:328 - that file is 889 lines, windows only, never open it whole. Three strands: footwork, conditioning, technique. NOT arms/torso - those are already two of the six body regions used for injury and recovery, and one word must not mean two things in one save. attribute_for may only ever return one of the seven existing attributes or the empty string; that function is where U18's refusal of an eighth attribute lives in code. Do not touch FightSimulation.gd (R80), RingStagePanel.gd (C59/U19), TechniqueTrainingCoordinator.gd or TrainingHubPanel.gd. Trap: dominant() on a tie returns the empty string, and share() on an empty ledger is 0.0 for every strand - never a third each. Parse gate, focused test, full suite once before the commit; rc=0 is not a pass, read the SUITE line.
